actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
